reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines tickets in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492.** Source: "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers at the Eau Claire yard, Dock Doors 14–18, weren't getting SMS bay assignments at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the fix worked.
2. **#4419.** Source: "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea opened it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 for firmware testing. The note has no date or resolution.

Things to know before it goes in the weekly notes:
- The two numbers are written in different formats ("PD-" prefix vs. none), and both involve Door 14. I can't tell from the notes whether they're separate tickets or the same one written two ways.
- Moss's other notes list tickets #4409 and #4412 and feature request FR-882, but those are for Central team accounts, not Quarrendon. Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" is about a company that isn't a customer.
- I only looked at what you can see yourself: the shared digest files and your channels. Moss hasn't posted in either of the shared channels Moss is in, so there may be more tickets in places neither of us can see.
